insights: 6,549 streamers share 112,666 mutual follows — density 0.0053: only ~0.53% of possible pairs are connected (a sparse network).
Small world: any two streamers in the giant component are on average 2.685 hops apart (diameter ≥ 7).
Heavy-tailed degree: the top 1% of streamers hold 18% of all tie endpoints (max degree 2040 vs median 18).
Partner assortativity = -0.254: verified Partners connect across Partner status more than within it.
Degree assortativity = -0.178: big hubs tend to link with small creators (hub-and-spoke / mentoring pattern).
Louvain found 6 communities (modularity 0.34); the largest, C1, holds 27% of streamers.
C1 is the most 'professional' community: 9% Partners vs 6% overall.
C5 has the highest share of mature-content streamers (50% vs 37% overall) — content style clusters in the network.
135 'hidden gems' sit in the top 15% by network centrality yet below median views — well-connected creators the audience hasn't found yet.
173 'bridges' have most of their ties outside their own community — natural brokers for cross-community collaborations.
